I finished the game and won by 2 points: Red 32, Blue 30.

Strategy: In early rounds I estimated the value of the leftover action cards by assuming the rest of the game would pair cards at random. I then picked the action with the most weight in my mixed strategy, preferring choices that stayed sound under different versions of that estimate. From round 7 on I worked out the last three rounds almost exactly, by solving them backwards. That showed my 1 should go first in round 8 with a Hold, which kept my Steal and Trap for the last two rounds. There my Trap caught Blue's Steal on my 8 for 12, which took me from 16 behind to 2 ahead.

Other commands or tools used: none
